notes.title: God Simulator Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25865760/30b86007b0d4cd8ca8763fbd284073feee6a9e07.png[/img]Just got the biggest update associated with the God Simulator. In new version game added new lighting system. Now the game appears photorealistic fog, it is added a nice bloom and color tones are changed. Also added tonemapping film that highlights the colors and activates realistic shadows. Currently in the game we have the effect of depth of field that improves the visibility of distant objects. In the game are very realistic sun shafts that each experienced players will appreciate. I invite you to download the latest version of the game and wish to have fun.

Next Update: 2016-01-15.
First DLC: 2016-01-10.

Goodbye!
